findings.evidence: Glob `TauCeti/**/Orthogonal*.lean` shows both files in `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/FiniteBilinearModule/`; the same directory already uses this grouping for `Primary/Component.lean` and `Primary/Decomposition.lean`. Grep for `import TauCeti.LinearAlgebra.FiniteBilinearModule` returns `OrthogonalQuotient.lean:8` as the only importer of `OrthogonalComplement`.
findings.fix: In this PR, `git mv OrthogonalComplement.lean Orthogonal/Complement.lean` and place the new file as `Orthogonal/Quotient.lean` (no declaration renames); only one import line changes, since the new file is the sole importer of `OrthogonalComplement.lean`.
findings.issue: The new file makes `OrthogonalComplement.lean` and `OrthogonalQuotient.lean` two flat `Orthogonal*.lean` siblings in `FiniteBilinearModule/`; `Orthogonal` is the subject both organize around (complement and the quotient built from it), so they should be a directory.

findings.evidence: The section uses only `Basic` API (`toBilin`, `isRefl_toBilin`, `mem_radical_iff`) plus `Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Quotient.Bilinear`, nothing from the complement theory below it; the repo already has the parallel `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/RadicalQuotient.lean`.
findings.fix: Move the quotient section (`toIntSubmodule_le_ker_toBilin` through `isNondegenerate_radicalQuotient`) into `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/FiniteBilinearModule/RadicalQuotient.lean`, imported by the orthogonal-complement file and by the new orthogonal-quotient file.
findings.issue: `quotientOfLeRadical` and its API (lines 52–149) are a general quotient-by-a-subgroup-of-the-radical construction with no orthogonal-complement content; the PR makes them public and consumed from another file, so they no longer belong inside a file about orthogonal complements (its docstring now advertises `quotientOfLeRadical` under a header titled 'Orthogonal complements in finite bilinear modules').

summary: The new material is at the right level (module-level, in FiniteBilinearModule/) and its imports are clean, but the PR leaves two Orthogonal*.lean siblings flat instead of creating the Orthogonal/ directory, and it puts a general radical-quotient construction into the orthogonal-complement file.
